title: Glioma and Pregnancy
summary: This study will include patients suffering from malignant brain tumor prior or during pregnancy in German participating centers. The aim of this study is to evaluate patients´ progression-free and overall survival and their quality of life with regard to pregnancy or their wish to become pregnant. Equally, data on pregnancy, data on children's birth and data on fertility protection and reproduction medicine will be assessed.
